answer.new_information: NVIDIA describes a new business model in which AI clouds procure NVIDIA infrastructure for AI-native, enterprise and ISV customers under a revenue-sharing and credit-support structure, with NVIDIA earning standard product revenue plus a share of cloud revenue on supported capacity. No dollar amounts, shares, percentages, contract sizes, or durations are stated. The Firmus Batam figures (360 MW, up to 170,000 GPUs) are campus-scale targets with no stated timeline or delivery status, and are company-stated plans rather than confirmed capacity. Sharon AI and Firmus quotes are party statements with no quantified commitment.
